title: Stuck on a blank resume? Try this... ✍️
description:
Stuck on what to write for your resume? Try using template job descriptions to see what companies are looking for. Check out places like Greenhouse or Monster and look at these templates for your field. Search for title + job description and even though these job descritions are more general and high level that can be a great start to a session of resume or LinkedIn profile updating. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobsearching #resumetips
